limitations: JS replica uses parent-inspired layout/semantics but is not a byte-identical Python replay

Weights are reproducibly trained but not retained as immutable checkpoint binaries
Action receipt fingerprints are FNV64 diagnostic hashes, not cryptographic signatures
Per-inference latency percentiles and process RSS require a separate instrumented Node run
